# mailintel

Resolve email providers and IMAP/SMTP connection settings from any email address or domain. Zero npm dependencies.

## Install

npm install mailintel

## API

```ts
import { mailintel } from 'mailintel';

// Single email - returns MailintelResult
const result = await mailintel('user@gmail.com');

// Array of emails - returns MailintelResult[]
const results = await mailintel(['user@gmail.com', 'ceo@acme-corp.com']);

// Domain only (no email) - returns MailintelResult, username stays as template
const result = await mailintel('acme-corp.com');
```

## Factory (custom options)

```ts
import { createMailintel } from 'mailintel';

const mi = createMailintel({
  mxLookup: 'google',     // 'cloudflare' (default) | 'google' | true | false
  ispdb: true,             // Thunderbird ISPDB fallback (default: true)
  timeout: 5000,           // Network timeout in ms
  cache: true,             // In-memory cache (default: true)
  cacheTtl: 1800000,       // Cache TTL in ms (default: 30 min)
});

const result = await mi('user@example.com');
mi.clearCache();
```

## MailintelResult

```ts
{
  email: string;             // Input email or "" if domain-only
  domain: string;            // Extracted domain
  provider: string | null;   // "google", "microsoft", "zoho", etc.
  mx: string | null;         // Primary MX hostname from DNS
  type: 'free' | 'business' | 'unknown';
  isFree: boolean;
  hasMx: boolean;
  connection: ConnectionInfo | null;  // null when status is not "ok"
  status: 'ok' | 'no-mx-records' | 'unknown-provider' | 'lookup-disabled';
  confidence: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
  source: 'override' | 'known-domain' | 'mx-lookup' | null;
  raw: { mx, dns, ispdb };  // Raw responses for debugging
}
```

## ConnectionInfo

```ts
{
  imap: { host: string; port: number; secure: boolean };
  smtp: { host: string; port: number; secure: boolean };
  username: string;          // Resolved value, e.g. "user@gmail.com"
  usernameTemplate: string;  // Raw template: "%EMAILADDRESS%" | "%EMAILLOCALPART%" | "%EMAILDOMAIN%"
}
```

## Status values

- `"ok"` - connection settings found
- `"no-mx-records"` - DNS returned no MX records for this domain
- `"unknown-provider"` - provider not recognized or no IMAP/SMTP settings available for it
- `"lookup-disabled"` - MX lookup disabled and domain not in known list

## Key behaviors

- Never throws - always returns a result
- Known domains (~50 built-in) resolve instantly with zero network calls
- At most 2 HTTP requests per uncached lookup (DNS + ISPDB)
- Results cached by domain (different emails on same domain share cache)
- username is already resolved from the template using the input email
- Domain-only input: username stays as the raw template since there's no email to resolve
